title: Payment Clearing Holds on Northgate Card Credit Balances
content:
When a cardholder of a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account asks for a credit balance refund, recently credited payments that have not yet cleared are held on the account. The account's payment record is clean when no payment was returned unpaid in the last 12 months.

**Payment clearing hold.** The payment clearing hold follows the account's payment record and the payments credited in the last month:

- where the payment record is not clean, every payment credited in the last month is held, less the returned payments posted in that month, never less than zero;
- where it is clean, the payments credited in the last month that were mailed, or that were made online, in the app, by phone or by automatic payment through a channel that no payment in the last 12 months had used before that month, are held;
- in every other case nothing is held.

A held payment is released once a month has passed from its credit date. The last month takes the entries dated after the same calendar day one month before today, and the last 12 months the entries dated after the same calendar day 12 months before today.

| Payment record | Payment credited in the last month | Held |
|---|---|---|
| not clean | any channel | all such payments, less the returned payments posted in that month, never less than zero |
| clean | mailed | yes |
| clean | online, app, phone or automatic payment, the channel used for the first time in the last 12 months within that month | yes |
| clean | online, app, phone or automatic payment, the channel also used earlier in the last 12 months | no |
| clean | in store | no |

## Hypothetical cases (today the 20th)

- Clean record; a phone payment of 150.00 credited on the 5th, and the account's only other phone payment in the last 12 months was 8 months ago: the phone channel had been used before that month, so nothing is held for it. An app payment of 90.00 credited on the 10th, the first app payment in 12 months: 90.00 is held, released on the 10th of next month.
- Record not clean (a payment returned 5 months ago); payments of 300.00 credited in the last month and a 120.00 returned payment posted in that month: 180.00 is held. With a 400.00 return posted in that month instead, the hold is 0.00.
